The head of NASA (the Administrator) during the historic Apollo 11 lunar landing was **Thomas O. Paine**.  
He was sworn in as NASA’s third administrator on **March 21, 1969**, and remained in that role through the July 20, 1969 launch and Moon landing.  

*Source: Wikipedia – “Thomas O. Paine” (Administrator of NASA, in‑office March 21, 1969 – September 15, 1970).*
